dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's a bit rough around the edges, but we have weapons, space, and everything else we might need.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So, limber up and let's go a few rounds. Don't worry about holding back!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: This place ain't half bad. I like it!
